title: Spanish-Style Lamb Leg with Umami Glaze
description: A flavorful lamb leg dish with a savory umami glaze, perfect for special occasions. This recipe is inspired by Spanish cuisine and is sure to impress.
instructions: Season the lamb leg with salt and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb leg until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and roast the lamb leg for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is cooking, mix the umami stir fry sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and rosemary in a small bowl.
After the lamb has roasted for 20 minutes, brush the umami glaze all over the meat.
Return the skillet to the oven and continue to roast for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the lamb reaches your desired level of doneness.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
